📢 Description

Zimbo Truckers was officially formed on 12th September 2025, starting as a small group of dedicated players who enjoyed doing random convoys together. Led by our CEO, TM, the group built its identity through fun and consistent drives that he streamed on TikTok, creating a unique and vibrant atmosphere. What began as a casual gathering has since grown into a structured company with over 60 members, completing more than 4,000 deliveries and covering millions of kilometers together. Today, Zimbo Truckers stands as a strong, organized community driven by unity, teamwork, and a shared passion for the road.

Join us as we celebrate ZiMBO TRUCKERS 1ST YEAR ANNIVERSSARY



🗣 Communication Language: English

💬 Voice Comms: ZiMBO TRUCKERS Discord https://discord.gg/xbkFA8DWRQ
event_request.rules:
## Rules for Participants
*  The Event Staff are recognized as; ''ZT1st Year | CC | CC, GM, Staff, Media or Similar."
* Impersonating Event Staff using the tags mentioned above is forbidden.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers, and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Cars and Bus are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Overtaking is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. You must park in the 'Public Parking' area if you don't have a designated slot.
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one-by-one) manner.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

## Event Rules for Event Staff
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. Following the rule above.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.
